proposed_from.topic: Hazard-lift identification of staggered-adoption ATT in aliased hidden Markov panels. Fix a known finite hidden order K, finite untreated-output alphabet, T>=2K-1, time-homogeneous untreated HMM law, adoption hazard depending on current hidden state but conditionally independent of future untreated innovations, full predictive Hankel rank, invertible killed dynamics, and positive cohort masses. Prove that hazards in the current-emission algebra identify every adopter cohort's finite untreated counterfactual output law and group-time ATT despite non-permutation latent fibers. Prove a generic converse when aliased states have unequal hazards and unequal forecasts, including an exact positive same-observed-law fiber with ATT gap 2/185. On a predeclared fixed Hankel chart and coefficient-normalized polynomial frame with positive rank/frame gaps, derive joint influence functions and simultaneous fixed-grid inference; put algebra-collision sequences in an explicit gray zone. Consumer: Kim--Lee's six-period binary video-on-demand staggered-adoption panel. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Exact symbolic checks verified the canonical stopped-law realization, HDK invariance, two strictly positive three-state fibers, stochastic and similarity identities, invariant positive-fiber means, the 2/185 negative-fiber gap, full length-two ranks, and an 8/285 converse derivative. Differentiating the fixed Gram solve, de-killing inverse, matrix powers, and quotient yielded the panel-level influence expansion. The aliased witness frame has singular values 2.00332688 and 0.99833932; along a legal rank-three collision sequence, the declared chart has sigma3=(10.33271+o(1))*delta, so fixed separation keeps the exact repeated-emission witness while excluding false uniform root-N claims. Bounded primary checks found HMM alias geometry and outcome-driven adoption simulations, but no causal hazard-lift ATT theorem. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Apply the predeclared K=3 chart, HDK residual, frame-gap, cohort-mass, and influence-precision diagnostics to the six-period Kim--Lee panel and establish that at least one preregistered observable stratum is empirically usable. EARLY KILL TEST: Reproduce the stated Hankel singular value, legal fibers, 2/185 gap, and analytic derivative, then run the fixed diagnostics on Kim--Lee; kill the application claim if every chart is ill-conditioned, HDK fails, precision is unusable, or the law lies in the collision gray zone. seed_details.anchor_locator: Theorem 2 and Sections 4.1--4.2 for the similarity family; the Introduction for the aliasing problem and Section 6 for the learning boundary.
seed_details.opportunity: Characterize when the stopped panel law identifies adopter counterfactual path laws even though aliased latent parameters vary on a non-permutation similarity fiber.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace recovery of a unique transition matrix by construction of the similarity-equivariant operator \(L\in\mathcal A_O\) satisfying \(L\bar v=\bar h\), then de-kill through \((I-L)^{-1}\bar K_0\).
seed_details.target_method_search: Searches combining aliased HMMs, state-dependent adoption, stopped laws, counterfactuals, and group-time ATT returned alias-identification papers and outcome-driven-adoption diagnostics, but no causal hazard-lift functional.
seed_details.referee_objection: This is immediate from Weiss and Nadler because all equivalent aliased HMMs are related by similarity.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their similarity fiber moves the state-dependent hazard and the de-killed forecast; constancy of the causal cohort functional requires the new hazard-in-emission-algebra certificate and fails on an explicit positive fiber when that certificate is absent.

seed_details.anchor_locator: Equation (9), Lemma 2, and Theorem 2 for admissible alias-preserving similarity transformations; the Introduction for the non-permutation ambiguity.
seed_details.opportunity: Prove that unequal hazards and unequal one-step forecasts inside an aliased block generically move group-time ATT along a legal same-observed-law path.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Differentiate the causal de-killed forecast along an alias-preserving stochastic similarity path rather than asking whether the latent transition itself is identifiable.
seed_details.target_method_search: The alias-equivalence literature supplies legal similarity directions, but the search found no derivative formula for a cohort counterfactual or an ATT nonidentification region.
seed_details.referee_objection: A single numerical counterexample would be a hand-tuned witness with no general content.
seed_details.rebuttal: The derivative is nonzero under strict positivity, unequal within-alias hazards, and unequal forecasts, producing a relatively open failure region; the rational \(2/185\) fiber is only an exact certificate.

seed_details.anchor_locator: Sections 3.1 and 3.4, especially Proposition 1 and the GMM weighting construction; the Introduction and Section 6 for robustness and misspecification boundaries.
seed_details.opportunity: Derive joint panel-level influence functions and simultaneous bands for the composed stopped-moment, Gram-solve, de-killing, power, and cohort-quotient map.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Differentiate the fixed observable chart and normalized algebra frame through de-killing before stacking cohort-time coordinates, rather than stopping at prediction-moment efficiency.
seed_details.target_method_search: Spectral GMM papers analyze prediction moments, and staggered-DiD papers analyze already-regular ATT scores; no source differentiates their hazard-lift composition.
seed_details.referee_objection: Once identification is written as a finite smooth map, the delta method and multiplier band are routine.
seed_details.rebuttal: The contribution is the explicit chart derivative and honest separation boundary; the generic delta method is presented as supporting inference rather than the paper's sole novelty.

seed_details.anchor_locator: The Introduction and Section 6.1, especially Theorem 6 and its Kruskal-embedding proof for generic finite-window HMM identification.
seed_details.opportunity: Give an exact necessary-and-sufficient observable criterion for singleton cohort forecasts over the full set of legal hazard lifts, including exceptional regimes in which hazard algebra fails but the target is constant.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace generic recovery of all latent parameters by elimination over the legal positive lift fiber and test constancy of finitely many causal rational functionals.
seed_details.target_method_search: Generic HMM identification leaves exceptional varieties unresolved, and no located paper classifies target-specific constancy on the state-dependent-stopping fiber.
seed_details.referee_objection: The legal-lift set is merely a restatement of identification as constancy over compatible models.
seed_details.rebuttal: A publishable solution must eliminate latent coordinates into a computable observable criterion; that elimination is not supplied by the restatement and remains genuinely open.

seed_details.anchor_locator: Theorem 6 and Section 4.2 for singular-value-dependent error bounds, together with the Introduction and Appendix B perturbation lemmas.
seed_details.opportunity: Locate the maximal shrinking Hankel-gap and frame-gap region supporting stabilized, uniformly honest simultaneous ATT inference, with a matching two-path impossibility outside it.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Propagate thresholding or Tikhonov bias through the nonlinear de-killing and cohort normalization rather than bounding only HMM prediction error.
seed_details.target_method_search: Rank-robust low-rank inference covers linear high-dimensional functionals, while weak-identification theory covers generic drifting experiments; neither gives the nonlinear hazard-lift frontier.
seed_details.referee_objection: This is generic weak identification with the smallest singular value renamed.
seed_details.rebuttal: The relevant strength is a pair of chart and algebra-frame gaps whose effects pass through inverses, a polynomial solve, and a causal quotient; the attainable phase must be derived for that composed target.

seed_details.anchor_locator: Sections 1.1, 2.1--2.3, 3.2, 4.1, and 5 for the six-period cohort-time design, binary VoD outcome, simultaneous inference, and application limits.
seed_details.opportunity: Construct a preregistered joint observable certificate for predictive rank, hazard-algebra residual, inverse and frame separation, cohort support, and precision in the Netflix--IPTV panel.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace post-matching balance checks by simultaneous inference on fixed stopped-word moments and conditioning diagnostics before reporting any latent-state ATT.
seed_details.target_method_search: The application reports observed-history matching and cohort-time uncertainty, while HMM redundancy papers diagnose likelihood geometry; no joint causal-usability certificate was located.
seed_details.referee_objection: A diagnostic checklist is an application appendix, not a theorem-level contribution.
seed_details.rebuttal: The joint level and gray-zone classification can be formal, but without access to the data it cannot presently certify the named consumer and therefore remains an empirical open question.

seed_details.anchor_locator: The prior core's open-ended question on constrained efficiency and its review's tangent-space normal-equations strengthening path.
seed_details.opportunity: Project the saturated stopped-law gradient onto the quotient tangent space of the time-homogeneous killed HMM and characterize strict efficiency gains.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Parameterize observable scores modulo similarity and alias directions before applying the canonical-gradient projection.
seed_details.target_method_search: Finite-moment efficiency and spectral latent-variable asymptotics are adjacent, but no paper located gives the quotient tangent space for a state-dependent stopped HMM causal functional.
seed_details.referee_objection: The model is finite-dimensional, so efficiency is just inverse Fisher information.
seed_details.rebuttal: Aliased similarity fibers make the latent parameterization singular; the score quotient and invariant target derivative must be constructed before an information inverse is meaningful.

seed_details.anchor_locator: The prior proposal's honest-scope boundary states that approximate common kernels remain outside its theorem, and its project justification identifies the exact absorbing-boundary gap.
seed_details.opportunity: Derive sharp ATT regions and sign-breakdown radii when hazard algebra or homogeneous killed dynamics holds only within an observable tolerance \(\varepsilon\).
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Optimize the causal rational functional over a compact positive semialgebraic HMM fiber rather than solve the exact algebra equation.
seed_details.target_method_search: Dynamic-panel sharp bounds and calibrated projection are occupied separately, but the exact relaxed hazard-lift feasible set and its breakdown radius were not located.
seed_details.referee_objection: This is an immediate nonlinear-program sensitivity analysis once the exact model is written down.
seed_details.rebuttal: Sharpness requires endpoint attainment and a valid critical-radius inference argument across changing active constraints; the prior proposal explicitly leaves approximate common transitions unresolved.

seed_details.anchor_locator: Section 4.1 and Table 1 for continuous viewing-hour outcomes, with Sections 1 and 5 for motivation and limitations.
seed_details.opportunity: Replace the finite emission algebra by a multiplication-operator closure that identifies cohort counterfactual means for continuous untreated outcomes.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace finite polynomial interpolation of emission profiles by a functional-calculus or completeness argument for the continuous emission family.
seed_details.target_method_search: Continuous-output HMM identification exists under distinct or linearly independent emissions, but no evidence located supports hazard-lift invariance under genuinely aliased continuous emissions.
seed_details.referee_objection: Under exact aliasing, the finite proof carries over by partitioning equal emission laws, so this is only a notation change.
seed_details.rebuttal: A nontrivial extension would require approximate or infinite emission-profile classes, but no defensible theorem-level kernel was established in the scan.
